template-injection.notes: jactionlint reports untrusted contexts in expressions. zizmor also covers env indirection, github-script and more contexts.

hardcoded-container-credentials.notes: The credentials rule reports a literal password in container or services credentials.

excessive-permissions.notes: Workflow-level write scopes and write-all (excessive-permissions), and a job without any permissions (missing-permissions). Job-level write scopes are reported only on privileged triggers, while zizmor does not report job-level scopes.

unpinned-uses.notes: The blanket hash-pin policy and the per-pattern policies (hash-pin, ref-pin, any) for actions, reusable workflows and docker:// images. Supported patterns are *, owner/*, owner/repo and owner/repo/path.

unpinned-images.notes: container: and services: images, by digest. Images in docker:// uses: are reported as unpinned-uses.

unsound-ternary.notes: jactionlint reports the falsy ternary idiom. zizmor 1.30.1 has no audit of this name, so this entry stays inert until a matching audit exists.

forbidden-uses.notes: required-actions enforces a required set of actions. zizmor's allow and deny lists are the inverse and are not covered yet.

undocumented-permissions.notes: Scopes above read need a comment (read scopes too with include-read). Comments that only drive a tool do not count.

self-repository.notes: ./ in uses: of steps and reusable workflow calls, with an unsafe fix to $/.

github-app.notes: actions/create-github-app-token only: skip-token-revoke, owner without repositories and missing permission-* inputs.

artipacked.notes: actions/checkout without persist-credentials: false, with a fix.

cache-poisoning.notes: Caches restored in release workflows for a fixed table of cache actions, and cache-mode: write on privileged triggers.
